notes: Open, buggy-only pair: there is no fixed commit, so 'fixed' is null; the issue's proposed guard was not simulated (that would require editing library source). Reproduces on the Triton CPU interpreter: on 8c7a5078 every forward-only call (input.requires_grad False; plain call and under torch.no_grad(); reductions mean/sum/none) zeroes the caller's logits at exactly the rows whose target == ignore_index (3 of 8 rows per call, 18 rows over 6 calls, expected 0); counted rows are byte-identical and returned losses match float64 torch (max abs err 1.3e-6); control with no ignored targets changes 0 rows. HEAD check: src/liger_kernel/ops/cross_entropy.py is blob b2bfba14 at both 8c7a5078 and the harness clone HEAD 37607058 (lines 104-108 identical, unguarded store), as are transformers/functional.py, transformers/cross_entropy.py, ops/utils.py and test_cross_entropy.py. By design and NOT this bug (recorded in metrics.by_design_grad_write): with input.requires_grad True the forward writes d(loss)/d(input) into input (all 8 rows change, contents = float64 gradient within 7.9e-9), also under torch.no_grad() because HAS_GRADIENTS = _input.requires_grad, and for mean/sum input.grad aliases input's storage after backward. Suggested property-check rule: input modified while input.requires_grad is True = by design; modified while input.requires_grad is False = B5. The caller only sees B5 when input.stride(-1) == 1 (otherwise Liger copies first). Kernel agreement on 8c7a5078 (scripts/harness/ref_vs_kernel_ce.py): 45/45 in-scope configs agree on outputs and gradients; informationally, all 4 forward-only draws with ignored rows had exactly their ignored rows modified. Liger's own suite (full file, 185 tests): 68 passed / 41 failed / 76 skipped; all 41 failures are interpreter limitations (weight/softcap paths) or tolerance/overflow problems on the torch-CPU reference side, and no test checks input mutation, so the suite does not detect B5. Separate, unlabeled defect found at this commit (and HEAD): an input with stride(-1) != 1 gets its own logits back as the gradient (harness_only/phase1/ce_extra_last_dim_stride_probe.py); out of the documented scope, see ce_notes.md section 5.
